claims.title: Quadratic-wave coherent current, auxiliary energy and resolving-window costs

quoted_fields.interface: Use symmetric C1 K(t), smooth decaying data in a compact positive null-frequency band and the source's extra velocity and conserved W=U+q.v/2 coordinates. The accepted affine identity consumes an already supplied nonnegative transported density. The accepted abstract majorant consumes a finite-length absolutely continuous normalized Hilbert curve. The accepted residual inequality consumes finite real-dimensional positive moments with the stated integrability. The full field transform, Dirichlet existence interface, wall energy and projection require their missing governing proofs.
quoted_fields.failure: The auxiliary affine connection is distinct from the physical Brinkmann Levi-Civita connection. Whole-Hilbert-space fixed-strength positive-window domination is stricter than restricted amplitudes or derivative-assisted recovery; its reported 1+NT trace obstruction is not an obstruction to all local smoothing. Quadratic passive-background rigidity assumes K invertible at one time and does not cover other lifts or nonquadratic backgrounds. Beyond-quadratic O(N^-1) is an integrated scalar budget with derivative/moment hypotheses, not smallness of all tensor components. Arbitrary Riemannian waves, matrix principal symbols and nonlinear interacting fields are outside scope.
